findings.issue: The copy of the encoded call from its bytes buffer into the call buffer is printed as a word loop, even with the constant length 68, so the call shows raw memory instead of transfer(caller, amount) / transferFrom(...).
findings.rule: 'i = 0; while i < n: mem[d + i] = mem[s + i]; i += 32' is the copy 'mem[d len n] = mem[s len n]' (plus a zero tail word when n % 32 != 0) when the ranges do not overlap; with the copy known, the call buffer's selector and words decode as usual.

summary: Faithful; the only source loop is present but printed as 'while True' with the function tail inside, and SafeERC20 payload copies stay word loops so token transfers lose their decoded call; mulDiv is expanded.
